text: QuestionAndriy LobatskiyAndriy Lobatskiy8:28 AM TodayTwo cabinets are stacked, one on top of the other, and both end at the same point on the left.1. In this configuration, do we use one full-height side panel that covers both cabinets, or two separate side panels, one for each cabinet?2. How should it be priced: as one side panel, or as two separate side panels?3. If it is one side panel, where do we get its price? Today side panels come from a fixed set of SKUs based on cabinet height. Is there a SKU / price list for the combined height (for example 28 + 28 or 35 + 35) and for each depth (46 / 50)? If not, is there a formula we should use?

text: AnswerCan we set rules for different heights? There are compatibility rules based on combined height.50 and 56 H - one full side panel.- (25+25) and (28 + 28)70 and 76 H - separate side panels. SP style must be the same for both cabinets; top and bottom it should be auto-applied to both the top and bottom cabs- (35 + 35) and (38 + 38)
